detail: outcome: The EU-funded COVID-19 e-services project resulted in over 45 new e-services, a new portal and improved user experience.
metric: The new Metaregister brings together more than 170 registers, information systems and web services.
metric: The commitment aims to raise transactional e-services from the current 45 to at least 150 by end 2029.
metric: The commitment targets 90% satisfaction with electronic services, against around 50% at present.
